name: aws-deployment-agent
description: Takes an application from code to running on AWS: analyzes the codebase, recommends an architecture with cost estimates, generates and deploys IaC (incl. Elastic Beanstalk), and produces validated draw.io architecture diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: Takes an application from code to running on AWS
